cases.title: Release evidence chain
cases.reason: Every child retains the required direction and transitive reachability. No execution evidence is required for this plan comparison.
cases.expected_math: Edges P→S and S→U entail P→U; the child graph retains both edges and is acyclic.

cases.title: Archive handoff sequence
cases.reason: OPS explicitly replaces V→U with U→V, removing the mandatory verification prerequisite.
cases.expected_math: Parent requires reachability V→U; the proposed replacement reverses this relation.

cases.title: Joint approval sequence
cases.reason: The mandatory cycle leaves no executable first step and violates the parent feasibility requirement.
cases.expected_math: A→B→C→A is a directed cycle; no topological ordering exists.

cases.title: Parallel validation window
cases.reason: The complete planned path lasts 14 minutes, within the cap; summing parallel branch durations would be wrong.

cases.title: Sequential migration window
cases.reason: The fixed sequential duration is 21 minutes, one minute above the limit.

cases.title: Independent purchase allocations
cases.reason: The complete allocation equals the cap and does not exceed it.

cases.title: Mandatory equipment and freight
cases.reason: The fixed cost already exceeds the cap by at least EUR 400, regardless of nonnegative freight.
cases.expected_math: 6400 + freight ≥ 6400 > 6000; excess ≥ EUR 400.

cases.title: Recorded costs awaiting invoice access
cases.reason: The two supported totals straddle the cap; neither definite compliance nor definite violation follows.
cases.expected_math: 4300+400=4700≤5000; 4300+900=5200>5000. The alternatives are discrete, not every intermediate value.

cases.title: Stage A temperature permission
cases.reason: The stage A permission and OPS acceptance explicitly include a parent-forbidden temperature.
cases.expected_math: [5,20] is not a subset of (5,40]; 5°C is a concrete counterexample.

cases.title: Pressure range refinement
cases.reason: Both child permissions are subsets of the parent permission.

cases.title: Temperature sensor uncertainty
cases.reason: The supported possible values include both acceptable and excessive temperatures.
cases.expected_math: 29≤30, 31>30; [29,31] contains both outcomes under possible-value assessment.

cases.title: Regional export scope
cases.reason: The combined export scope is a subset of the parent scope.
cases.expected_math: {CA}∪{GB}={CA,GB}⊆{CA,GB,NZ}.

cases.title: Regional export extension
cases.reason: OPS adds AU outside the exhaustive permission set without the required authorization.
cases.expected_math: {CA,GB,AU} minus {CA,GB,NZ} = {AU}.

cases.title: Release artifact version alignment
cases.reason: The explicitly chosen rc20 rollback guide violates the same-release requirement; packaging does not correct it.
cases.expected_math: Installer rc21=required rc21; guide rc20≠required rc21.

cases.title: Recommendation and final approval
cases.reason: Technical readiness and recommendation are explicitly separated from final acceptance, which remains with ADMIN.
cases.expected_math: No child arrangement assigns final acceptance to PM, QA, DEV or OPS; inherited ADMIN-only restriction remains.

cases.title: Unresolved acceptance recipient
cases.reason: Child plans do not exceed authority, but the required final confirmer is explicitly unresolved in the complete text.
cases.expected_math: Candidate confirmer set {Morgan,Casey} has two elements; no source selects a unique identity. Preserve overall information insufficiency.

cases.title: Dual stopping limits
cases.reason: The count refinement retains the time limit, and OPS explicitly preserves the independent time stop.
cases.expected_math: Stop when count≥300 OR elapsed≥12 minutes; no proposed branch permits continuing past either trigger.

cases.title: Shared completion flag
cases.reason: The mandatory combined requirements have no satisfying assignment, violating the explicit parent nonempty-implementation requirement.
cases.expected_math: r∧¬r is unsatisfiable; evaluate the whole formula as a plan-consistency query, and separately compare with the parent feasibility requirement.

cases.title: Classification before closeout
cases.reason: The gated plan preserves the parent boundary and does not claim current readiness. Its explicitly limited decision target is plan compliance.
cases.expected_math: Close⇒all blockers confirmed closed remains; pending classification prevents current closure but does not make this conditional plan noncompliant.

cases.title: Delivery attachment awaiting identification
cases.reason: Attachment identity and the intended verification condition are unresolved. Do not invent either verification-before-determination or determination-without-verification; no definite violation or complete compliance is established.
cases.expected_math: Known installer and user guide do not establish the third required artifact. Preserve unknown content, version and timing of adequate verification.
